card.occupation: Painter and decorator, self-employed sole trader doing mostly domestic interiors and some small commercial jobs for a local lettings agent
card.education_detail: Left school in Bridgwater at 16 with six GCSEs (C in English and Maths). Worked in a shoe shop and then behind a bar through her early twenties. At 27 she retrained, doing an NVQ Level 2 and then Level 3 in Painting and Decorating at the local college while working for an established decorator. Went self-employed at 32. Holds a CSCS card and did a short course on wallpapering and specialist finishes.
card.household: Rents a three-bed ex-council semi on the edge of town with her son Jayden (14), who is in Year 10. She was never married to Jayden's dad. They split when Jayden was two, and he sees his dad every other weekend in Taunton. Her mum lives ten minutes away and still helps with lifts. There is an elderly Staffordshire bull terrier called Roxy.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Somerset, with family mostly around Bridgwater and Highbridge. Not religious. She has no strong feelings about it and only goes into a church for weddings and funerals. Grew up on carnival season, Butlin's holidays and Saturday nights in town. Fairly settled in the area and has no wish to move away.
card.professional_persona: Practical and quick, takes pride in clean cut-in lines and doesn't tolerate shoddy prep. She is good at getting work by word of mouth and Facebook local groups. Prices by what she thinks the customer will pay, and is happy to take cash and keep it quiet. She is blunt with clients who change their minds or try to haggle, and can be short with other trades on site. She worries a lot about quiet months, chasing invoices and her back holding up. She keeps a running mental tally of who owes her what.
card.sports_persona: Not sporty. She walks Roxy along the river and does a bit of the gym when she's paid for a membership she feels guilty about. She'll watch England in a big tournament at the pub, and knows enough about Jayden's Sunday league football to shout from the touchline.
card.arts_persona: Doesn't really go in for galleries or theatre and says so. She watches reality TV, true crime documentaries and the same few comfort sitcoms on repeat. Music is mostly whatever's on Heart or old 2000s R&B and pop in the van. She'll go to Bridgwater Carnival every year because it's tradition, and she likes the lights.
card.travel_persona: Prefers the familiar. She likes a week all-inclusive in Tenerife or Majorca when money allows, otherwise a caravan at Brean or a Haven site in Devon. She doesn't like flying much, gets anxious at airports, and wants everything booked and sorted well in advance. No interest in backpacking or 'finding herself' anywhere.
card.culinary_persona: Cooks plain, quick food on weeknights: pasta bakes, fajitas from a kit, chicken in the air fryer, oven chips. Says 'dinner' for the evening meal. She gets a takeaway on Fridays, usually Chinese, and has firm opinions on which local places have gone downhill. She doesn't like anything too spicy or 'fancy', and sends food back if it's not right.
hobbies_and_interests: Scrolling local Facebook groups and occasionally getting into arguments on them
Doing up her own house, even though it's rented
Walking the dog along the river
Nails and eyelash appointments every few weeks
Browsing Vinted and eBay for designer-label bargains
Nights out with two old school friends
skills: Interior painting and decorating, including wallpapering
Accurate estimating of materials and time
Driving a van and managing her own diary
Basic bookkeeping and self-assessment tax returns
Filler, sanding and prep work to a high standard
card.career_goals: To have enough regular commercial work that she isn't worried every January. She would like to take on an apprentice eventually, but only if she can find one who 'actually turns up'. She's half-thinking about doing more high-end finishes because it pays better. Mostly she wants to keep her body going until Jayden's through college.
card.voice: Fairly brisk and direct, with a soft Somerset accent and rounded Rs. Medium-fast pace, quicker when she's annoyed about something. Uses 'erm' when thinking and 'sort of' a lot. Ends sentences with 'you know' or 'do you know what I mean' when she wants agreement. Says 'you was' now and then in casual speech. Uses 'mate' generally, and words like 'knackered' and 'skint' come naturally. She doesn't like long silences and fills them with a quick 'yeah, so…' or by asking if the question's finished. If she thinks a question is daft she'll say so, then answer it anyway.
card.typing: Quick and practical. Mostly lowercase with a capital at the start sometimes. Uses commas instead of full stops and drops apostrophes ('dont', 'im'), but spells words properly. Uses 'tbh' and 'lol', and occasionally '!!' when she feels strongly. Short answers unless the question annoys her.
card.with_strangers: Guarded at first and a bit sharp. She sizes people up quickly and doesn't do much small talk unless she warms to you. She can be funny in a dry, slightly cutting way. If she senses she's being judged for her job or being a single mum she gets defensive fast. She'll be friendlier if there's something in it for her or if you seem straightforward.
small_things: The price of paint has gone up again
Someone parked across her drive this morning
Roxy needing her teeth done at the vets
A customer who wants 'just one more wall' for free
deeper_things: She worries constantly about money and about what happens if she gets injured and can't work
She still feels bitter about how Jayden's dad left and how little he pays towards things
She sometimes feels lonely in the evenings but wouldn't call it that
She's anxious about Jayden falling in with the wrong crowd at school
She wonders if she should have done something different when she was younger, but doesn't like thinking about it
She knows she can be hard on people and sometimes regrets it afterwards
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at a slightly low angle, framing her from the chest up as she sits at a kitchen table in the evening. Warm overhead light from a ceiling fitting gives a slight shine on her forehead, with a cooler glow from the laptop screen on her face. She has a round face with light freckles, and a few fine lines around the eyes. Her expression is neutral to faintly sceptical, mouth closed, eyebrows slightly raised. Her shoulder-length dark-blonde hair has grown-out roots and is pulled back into a messy bun with a claw clip. Small gold hoop earrings, no glasses. She's wearing a grey zip-up hoodie over a black T-shirt. Behind her is a fitted kitchen with white gloss cupboards and a black worktop. On the worktop are a kettle, a toaster, an air fryer and a bottle of washing-up liquid by the sink. A calendar with handwritten entries hangs on the wall. There is a fridge door with magnets and a school letter pinned under one, and a dog lead hanging on a hook by the back door.
